title: Lovely Sweet Egyptian Dates Skewers
description: A sweet and crunchy Egyptian dish featuring dried fruit, perfect for a snack or dessert, and friendly to all diets including those found in Buddhist temples.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the honey, lemon juice, and water until well combined.
Add the dried dates to the bowl and toss to coat with the honey mixture.
Thread the dates, almonds, and pistachios onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Sprinkle the coconut flakes and sesame seeds over the skewers.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 5 minutes, turning occasionally.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers warm or at room temperature.
